Subject: Grafana Marketplace onboarding: initial spec and next steps

Hey Priyom / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week — super excited about getting Redwood listed in the Grafana Marketplace. I attached a first-pass Marketplace spec (GrafanaMarketplaceSpec_v1.pdf) that lays out technical, billing, and listing metadata we typically need.

High-level asks from our side: 
- Minimum telemetry + example dashboard (OTel-compatible)
- A deployment manifest we can reference for the listing (manifest.yaml)
- A short integration checklist filled out by Redwood (see proposed columns)

Would you be able to review and confirm:
1) Whether you can provide a staging tenant for testing (recommended)
2) An initial ETA for the checklist + manifest (rough ballpark is fine)

I copied Partner Ops for intake and licensing coordination. We can target an internal kickoff early next week if that works for your team.

Attachments: GrafanaMarketplaceSpec_v1.pdf

Best,
Jordan Wells

Subject: Re: Grafana Marketplace onboarding: initial spec and next steps

Jordan — thanks, received. Attaching a completed integration checklist template we use (Redwood-Integration-Checklist.xlsx) to speed the intake. A few quick clarifying Qs up front: 

- Staging tenant: do you provide credentials or prefer we spin our own test org and you run a validation sweep?
- OTel expectations: do you require collector-side sampling config or can we supply a recommended config in the manifest?
- Billing/plan metadata: do you prefer us to surface usage tiers (token/embedding units) or a link to our pricing page?

Plan on getting an initial pass back by end of day Thursday PST. Marcus/Stephanie — want to own the tech + docs side; Marcus, can you draft the collector config suggestions and a sample dashboard?

Attachments: Redwood-Integration-Checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Integrations | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Jordan Wells <jwells@grafana.com>

Cc: Grafana Partner Ops <partners@grafana.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Grafana Marketplace onboarding: initial spec and next steps

Thanks Priyom — answers inline: 

- Staging tenant: Grafana will provision a temporary staging org and we will send credentials once the manifest is accepted. We typically run a basic validation (connectivity, OTel metrics + traces, dashboard rendering). Expect a staging window of ~30 days.
- OTel: recommended to supply a collector config in the manifest. We validate service.name + resource attributes. Sampling settings are flexible, but please include a note about ideal sampling for demo vs. production.
- Billing: link to a pricing page is fine for the Marketplace, but for any bundled billing / resale we need explicit plan metadata (we can follow up on that).

I attached the spec and a sample manifest we usually accept. Drive link for larger artifacts: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4dGRAFY-spec

Next steps: if Redwood can return the checklist + manifest by Thu EOD PST, Partner Ops will schedule a kickoff and provisioning.

Attachments: GrafanaMarketplaceSpec_v1.pdf, manifest.yaml

Jordan
Partner Operations | Grafana Labs
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Grafana Marketplace onboarding: initial spec and next steps

Jordan — quick technical follow-ups (copying quoted text from your note):

> - OTel: recommended to supply a collector config in the manifest. We validate service.name + resource attributes.

For our engineering handoff we want to confirm:
1) Which OTel exporter do you validate against? (prometheus remote_write vs. native grafana-agent OTLP acceptance)
2) Do you validate logs/traces in the same pass or only metrics for the first sweep?
3) Any preferred authentication method for the staging tenant (API key vs. OAuth service account)?

We will prepare two variants of the collector config (OTLP GRPC + Prometheus scrape adapter) and a minimal sample app that emits traces and metrics for the dashboard. Can you confirm whether you want the sample app to include synthetic query load (recommended for dashboard rendering tests)?

Thanks — Marcus
